you have about 10 days for Fable 5.

that's how long the public still gets to touch the smartest model claude has ever shipped at full power. 

pause at 0:12 on the benchmark table and you'll see why that matters.

> 80.3% on agentic coding. best non-claude model sits at 58.6%
> 1932 on knowledge work. gpt 5.5 is at 1769
> top score on nearly every row in the table
> the longer and messier the task, the bigger the lead

now read the small print under that same table.

on cybersecurity and biology, the starred rows, your version already drops to opus 4.8 levels. 78% quietly becomes 40%. that's not the model getting dumber. that's the safeguard deciding you don't get the full one.

the version that keeps those numbers is mythos 5. defenders only. and the throttle only moves one way.

so this is the countdown. the door is open today. in 10 days nobody's promising it reads like this.

screenshot the table while it still does.

title: Fable 5 benchmark results compared with other models
author: BUG｜AI 前沿观察
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
Claude 新模型最重要的变化：AI 开始按身份分配能力权限

Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5。真正值得关注的不是 benchmark 又提高了多少，而是一个新的产品逻辑：同一个底层模型，开始根据用户身份和风险等级开放不同能力。

Fable 5 面向普通用户，但在高风险网络安全和生物领域设置了更严格的分类器与回退机制。部分请求不会由 Fable 5 直接回答，而会转交给能力较低的模型。

Mythos 5 使用相同的底层模型，却会为特定网络防御机构和关键基础设施合作方解除部分限制。未来，经过审核的生物研究人员也可能获得受控访问。

这意味着，前沿模型正在从“会员等级”走向“能力权限等级”。

01｜模型排行榜的重要性会下降

过去比较模型主要看速度、价格、上下文和跑分。以后还必须多问一句：你测试到的是哪个权限层级？

同一个模型在不同账户、地区、行业和调用环境里，实际表现可能并不相同。

02｜AI 产品的护城河不只是模型

当模型可以自主完成更长、更复杂的任务，身份认证、使用审计、权限升级、异常检测、操作撤销和责任追踪都会成为核心产品能力。

模型越能行动，这些基础设施就越重要。

03｜高能力 AI 可能形成新的不平等

如果最强能力只向大型机构、政府合作方和少数经过审核的组织开放，普通开发者与大型机构之间的差距就不再只是算力和资金，还包括一项新的稀缺资源：可获得的智能权限。

Anthropic 表示，Fable 5 可以处理更长周期的工程任务；Mythos 5 在内部蛋白质设计流程中将部分工作加速约十倍。这些结果目前主要来自官方和早期合作方测试，仍需要更多独立验证。

我的判断是：前沿 AI 正从“人人使用同一个聊天机器人”，进入“不同身份使用不同能力等级的智能系统”。

接下来真正值得观察的，不只是模型能做什么，而是谁可以使用、在什么条件下使用，以及出了问题由谁负责。

模型能力越强，权限设计就越重要。

来源：Anthropic 官方发布

title: Playable game prototype built with Fable 5
author: Samurayich
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.

originalText:
Claude Fable 5 went 5 for 5.
Opus 4.8 failed.
And Mythos - Anthropic's most powerful model - never even stepped on the field.

Someone decided to run a real test.
Five tasks you wouldn't expect from AI:
Map every asteroid in the Solar System using live NASA data.
Rebuild Apollo control panels from technical PDF files.
Build a World Cup shirt supply chain based on live game results.
Simulate the effect of solar storms at dawn.
Design a 100-acre fitness retreat layout.
Opus 4.8 — failed on several.
Fable 5 — passed all of them. Without exception.

But here's what most people missed.
Mythos — Anthropic's real flagship — wasn't even in the room.
It's locked inside Project Glasswing.
Available only to a handful of trusted organizations worldwide.
The public has never seen what it can do.

What just beat everything — isn't even their best version.
It's just what they decided to give us.

Makes you wonder what the people with real access are building right now.

Someone just built a playable Fruit Ninja game using Claude, Fable 5, Higgsfield MCP, and a single prompt.

Your camera tracks your hand in real time, turning your fingers into the controller as you slice through flying fruit.

What's remarkable isn't the game itself, it's how it was created.

We're witnessing a fundamental shift in how software gets built.

The distance between imagination and execution has never been shorter.
